name: Kanou Roko
source:
A second-year student at Tatesuga Academy. She's the class representative, and head of the history research club. Her specialty is Japanese history, with a particular focus in the Heian period. She is secretly popular among the boys and is best friends with Shizuka.

[From [url=https://www.nookgaming.com/kagami-games-to-release-7-visual-novels-including-sakura-moyu/]NookGaming[/url]]

She was adopted by Yoshitsune's parents,[spoiler] after being orphaned at young age. Her original surname is 宮簀(miyazu)[/spoiler]
